_comment: Frozen experimental configuration v1.0 for the journal submission. Every script in src/ reads or matches these values so that code, notebook, CSV/JSON results, figures, manuscript, PPT, and video all agree. This file is the single source of truth for hyperparameters -- if a number in the manuscript disagrees with this file, the file is authoritative and the manuscript has a bug.

primary_comparison.solved_definition: trailing-50-episode mean at the FINAL episode >= solve_threshold (not merely ever crossing it)

ablation_study.design: full 2^3 factorial (Gaussian MF x eligibility trace x adaptive epsilon), 8 configurations
ablation_study.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm, applied to all pairwise post-hoc comparisons across the 8 configurations

cross_environment_transfer.zero_shot: CartPole-tuned hyperparameters applied directly, no retuning
cross_environment_transfer.tuned: lambda, sigma_mult, epsilon_decay retuned per environment via the same sensitivity-sweep protocol

dqn_handrolled.architecture: MLP 4->64->64->2, ReLU, target network synced every 10 episodes
dqn_handrolled.note: included as a real, measured computational-cost reference point, not the primary accuracy baseline

rl_baselines.sb3_budget_rationale: 60,000 environment steps is the same order of magnitude as the FQL-GTA agent's own total-step budget over its 500-episode training run, and is standard practice for solving CartPole-v1 with SB3's default hyperparameters. Per-episode returns for SB3 agents are recovered from a Monitor wrapper and scored under the identical trailing-50-episode solved definition used for FQL, for comparability.
rl_baselines.seeds: 0-9 (10 seeds; smaller than the primary FQL comparison's 30 given the added compute of two additional deep-RL algorithms)

software_environment.key_packages: see requirements.txt / environment.yml for pinned minimum versions
